local grammar = require("grammar_parser")
local M = {}
function M.node(symbol)
    return {symbol = symbol, mark = nil, children = {}}
end
function M.parse(tokens, positions, source, sets, parse_table)
    local input, locations = {table.unpack(tokens)}, {table.unpack(positions)}
    input[#input + 1], locations[#locations + 1] = "$", #tokens + 1
    local root = M.node(source.start)
    local stack = {{symbol = "$"}, {symbol = source.start, node = root}}
    local result = {root = root, trace = {}, left_parse = {}, events = {}, counts = {predict = 0, match = 0, skip = 0, pop = 0, missing = 0, max_stack = 0}}
    local cursor, step = 1, 0
    while true do
        step = step + 1
        local top, token = stack[#stack], input[cursor]
        local before = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(stack) do
            before[#before + 1] = item.symbol
        end
        local remaining = {table.unpack(input, cursor)}
        local action, kind, terminate = nil, nil, false
        result.counts.max_stack = math.max(result.counts.max_stack, #stack)
        if top.symbol == "$" and token == "$" then
            action, terminate = "accept", true
        elseif top.symbol == "$" then
            action, kind = "error: skip " .. token, "skip"
        elseif not grammar.is_nonterminal(top.symbol) then
            if top.symbol == token then
                action = "match " .. token
                stack[#stack], cursor = nil, cursor + 1
                result.counts.match = result.counts.match + 1
            else
                action, kind = "error: missing " .. top.symbol, "missing"
                top.node.mark, stack[#stack] = "missing", nil
            end
        elseif parse_table.choices[top.symbol][token] then
            local number = parse_table.choices[top.symbol][token]
            local production = parse_table.productions[number]
            action = "predict " .. number .. ": " .. production.notation
            result.left_parse[#result.left_parse + 1] = number
            result.counts.predict = result.counts.predict + 1
            stack[#stack] = nil
            if #production.rhs == 0 then
                top.node.children[1] = M.node("%empty")
            else
                for _, symbol in ipairs(production.rhs) do
                    top.node.children[#top.node.children + 1] = M.node(symbol)
                end
                for index = #top.node.children, 1, -1 do
                    local node = top.node.children[index]
                    stack[#stack + 1] = {symbol = node.symbol, node = node}
                end
            end
        elseif token == "$" or sets.follow[top.symbol][token] then
            action, kind = "error: pop " .. top.symbol, "pop"
            top.node.mark, stack[#stack] = "error", nil
        else
            action, kind = "error: skip " .. token, "skip"
        end
        if kind then
            result.counts[kind] = result.counts[kind] + 1
            result.events[#result.events + 1] = {step = step, kind = kind, symbol = top.symbol, token = token, position = locations[cursor]}
            if kind == "skip" then
                cursor = cursor + 1
            end
        end
        result.trace[#result.trace + 1] = {tostring(step), table.concat(before, " "), table.concat(remaining, " "), action}
        if terminate then
            break
        end
    end
    return result
end
return M

local grammar = require("grammar_parser")
local M = {}
function M.terminal_order(values)
    local result = {}
    for value in pairs(values) do
        result[#result + 1] = value
    end
    table.sort(result, function(a, b)
        if a == "$" then
            return false
        elseif b == "$" then
            return true
        end
        return a < b
    end)
    return result
end
function M.terminals(source)
    local result = {}
    for _, lhs in ipairs(source.order) do
        for _, rhs in ipairs(source.rules[lhs]) do
            for _, symbol in ipairs(rhs) do
                if not grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) then
                    result[symbol] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return M.terminal_order(result)
end
local function merge(target, values)
    local changed = false
    for value in pairs(values) do
        if not target[value] then
            target[value], changed = true, true
        end
    end
    return changed
end
function M.sequence(symbols, nullable, first)
    local result = {}
    for _, symbol in ipairs(symbols) do
        if not grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) then
            result[symbol] = true
            return result, false
        end
        merge(result, first[symbol])
        if not nullable[symbol] then
            return result, false
        end
    end
    return result, true
end
function M.analyze(source)
    local result = {nullable = {}, first = {}, follow = {}, passes = {}, terminals = M.terminals(source)}
    for _, lhs in ipairs(source.order) do
        result.nullable[lhs], result.first[lhs], result.follow[lhs] = false, {}, {}
    end
    local changed, passes = true, 0
    while changed do
        changed, passes = false, passes + 1
        for _, lhs in ipairs(source.order) do
            if not result.nullable[lhs] then
                for _, rhs in ipairs(source.rules[lhs]) do
                    local empty = true
                    for _, symbol in ipairs(rhs) do
                        if not grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) or not result.nullable[symbol] then
                            empty = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if empty then
                        result.nullable[lhs], changed = true, true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    result.passes.nullable = passes
    changed, passes = true, 0
    while changed do
        changed, passes = false, passes + 1
        for _, lhs in ipairs(source.order) do
            for _, rhs in ipairs(source.rules[lhs]) do
                local values = M.sequence(rhs, result.nullable, result.first)
                if merge(result.first[lhs], values) then
                    changed = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    result.passes.first = passes
    result.follow[source.start]["$"] = true
    changed, passes = true, 0
    while changed do
        changed, passes = false, passes + 1
        for _, lhs in ipairs(source.order) do
            for _, rhs in ipairs(source.rules[lhs]) do
                for index, symbol in ipairs(rhs) do
                    if grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) then
                        local suffix = {table.unpack(rhs, index + 1)}
                        local values, empty = M.sequence(suffix, result.nullable, result.first)
                        if merge(result.follow[symbol], values) then
                            changed = true
                        end
                        if empty and merge(result.follow[symbol], result.follow[lhs]) then
                            changed = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    result.passes.follow = passes
    return result
end
return M

local M = {}
function M.is_nonterminal(symbol)
    return symbol:sub(1, 1) == "<" and symbol:sub(-1) == ">"
end
function M.alternative(symbols)
    return #symbols == 0 and "%empty" or table.concat(symbols, " ")
end
function M.production(lhs, rhs)
    return lhs .. " -> " .. M.alternative(rhs)
end
function M.copy(grammar)
    local result = {order = {table.unpack(grammar.order)}, rules = {}, start = grammar.start}
    for _, lhs in ipairs(grammar.order) do
        result.rules[lhs] = {}
        for _, rhs in ipairs(grammar.rules[lhs]) do
            result.rules[lhs][#result.rules[lhs] + 1] = {table.unpack(rhs)}
        end
    end
    return result
end
function M.same(first, second)
    if #first ~= #second then
        return false
    end
    for i, value in ipairs(first) do
        if value ~= second[i] then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end
function M.lex(line)
    local tokens, cursor = {}, 1
    while cursor <= #line do
        local character = line:sub(cursor, cursor)
        if character == " " then
            cursor = cursor + 1
        elseif character == "#" then
            break
        else
            local start, kind, value = cursor, "invalid", character
            if character == "<" then
                value = line:sub(cursor):match("^<[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*>")
                if value then
                    kind, cursor = "nonterminal", cursor + #value
                end
            elseif character == '"' then
                value = line:sub(cursor):match('^"([^ "]+)"')
                if value then
                    kind, cursor = "terminal", cursor + #value + 2
                end
            elseif character:match("[A-Za-z]") then
                value = line:sub(cursor):match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*")
                kind, cursor = "word", cursor + #value
            elseif line:sub(cursor, cursor + 2) == "::=" then
                kind, value, cursor = "definition", "::=", cursor + 3
            elseif character == "|" then
                kind, cursor = "separator", cursor + 1
            elseif character == "%" then
                local name = line:sub(cursor + 1):match("^[A-Za-z]*")
                if name == "empty" or name == "start" or name == "token" then
                    kind, value, cursor = "directive", "%" .. name, cursor + #name + 1
                end
            end
            if kind == "invalid" then
                value, cursor = character, start + 1
            end
            tokens[#tokens + 1] = {kind = kind, value = value, start = start, finish = cursor - 1}
            if kind == "invalid" then
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return tokens
end
local function error_column(tokens, cursor)
    return tokens[cursor] and tokens[cursor].start or tokens[#tokens].finish + 1
end
local function alternatives(tokens, cursor)
    local result = {}
    while true do
        local rhs = {}
        if not tokens[cursor] then
            return nil, error_column(tokens, cursor)
        end
        if tokens[cursor].kind == "directive" and tokens[cursor].value == "%empty" then
            cursor = cursor + 1
        elseif tokens[cursor].kind == "nonterminal" or tokens[cursor].kind == "terminal" or tokens[cursor].kind == "word" then
            while tokens[cursor] and (tokens[cursor].kind == "nonterminal" or tokens[cursor].kind == "terminal" or tokens[cursor].kind == "word") do
                rhs[#rhs + 1] = tokens[cursor].value
                cursor = cursor + 1
            end
        else
            return nil, error_column(tokens, cursor)
        end
        result[#result + 1] = rhs
        if not tokens[cursor] then
            return result
        end
        if tokens[cursor].kind ~= "separator" then
            return nil, error_column(tokens, cursor)
        end
        cursor = cursor + 1
    end
end
local function line_form(tokens)
    if #tokens == 0 then
        return "blank"
    end
    local first = tokens[1]
    if first.kind == "nonterminal" then
        if not tokens[2] or tokens[2].kind ~= "definition" then
            return nil, nil, nil, error_column(tokens, 2)
        end
        local rhs, column = alternatives(tokens, 3)
        return rhs and "rule" or nil, first.value, rhs, column
    elseif first.kind == "separator" then
        local rhs, column = alternatives(tokens, 2)
        return rhs and "continuation" or nil, nil, rhs, column
    elseif first.kind == "directive" and first.value == "%start" then
        if not tokens[2] or tokens[2].kind ~= "nonterminal" then
            return nil, nil, nil, error_column(tokens, 2)
        end
        if tokens[3] then
            return nil, nil, nil, error_column(tokens, 3)
        end
        return "start", tokens[2].value
    elseif first.kind == "directive" and first.value == "%token" then
        if not tokens[2] then
            return nil, nil, nil, error_column(tokens, 2)
        end
        local words = {}
        for i = 2, #tokens do
            if tokens[i].kind ~= "word" then
                return nil, nil, nil, error_column(tokens, i)
            end
            words[#words + 1] = tokens[i].value
        end
        return "declaration", nil, words
    end
    return nil, nil, nil, first.start
end
function M.parse(lines)
    local grammar = {order = {}, rules = {}, diagnostics = {}, declared = {}, word_first = {}, has_declarations = false}
    local attached = nil
    for number, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local tokens = M.lex(line)
        local kind, lhs, values, column = line_form(tokens)
        if not kind then
            grammar.diagnostics[#grammar.diagnostics + 1] = "line " .. number .. ": syntax error at column " .. column
            attached = nil
        elseif kind == "start" then
            if grammar.start then
                grammar.diagnostics[#grammar.diagnostics + 1] = "line " .. number .. ": duplicate %start"
            else
                grammar.start = lhs
            end
            attached = nil
        elseif kind == "declaration" then
            grammar.has_declarations = true
            for _, value in ipairs(values) do
                grammar.declared[value] = true
            end
            attached = nil
        elseif kind ~= "blank" then
            if kind == "rule" then
                if not grammar.rules[lhs] then
                    grammar.order[#grammar.order + 1] = lhs
                    grammar.rules[lhs] = {}
                end
                attached = lhs
            elseif not attached then
                grammar.diagnostics[#grammar.diagnostics + 1] = "line " .. number .. ": continuation without a rule"
            end
            if attached then
                for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do
                    if token.kind == "word" and not grammar.word_first[token.value] then
                        grammar.word_first[token.value] = number
                    end
                end
                for _, rhs in ipairs(values) do
                    local duplicate = false
                    for _, prior in ipairs(grammar.rules[attached]) do
                        if M.same(rhs, prior) then
                            duplicate = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if duplicate then
                        grammar.diagnostics[#grammar.diagnostics + 1] = "line " .. number .. ": duplicate alternative " .. M.production(attached, rhs)
                    else
                        grammar.rules[attached][#grammar.rules[attached] + 1] = rhs
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    grammar.start = grammar.start or grammar.order[1]
    return grammar
end
return M

local grammar = require("grammar_parser")
local first_follow = require("first_follow")
local M = {}
function M.number(source)
    local result = {}
    for _, lhs in ipairs(source.order) do
        for _, rhs in ipairs(source.rules[lhs]) do
            result[#result + 1] = {number = #result + 1, lhs = lhs, rhs = rhs, notation = grammar.production(lhs, rhs)}
        end
    end
    return result
end
function M.build(source, sets)
    local result = {productions = M.number(source), cells = {}, choices = {}, conflicts = {}}
    local terminals = {table.unpack(sets.terminals)}
    terminals[#terminals + 1] = "$"
    for _, lhs in ipairs(source.order) do
        result.cells[lhs], result.choices[lhs] = {}, {}
        for _, token in ipairs(terminals) do
            result.cells[lhs][token] = {}
        end
    end
    for _, production in ipairs(result.productions) do
        local values, empty = first_follow.sequence(production.rhs, sets.nullable, sets.first)
        production.predict, production.reasons = values, {}
        for token in pairs(values) do
            production.reasons[token] = "FIRST"
        end
        if empty then
            for token in pairs(sets.follow[production.lhs]) do
                if not values[token] then
                    values[token], production.reasons[token] = true, "FOLLOW"
                end
            end
        end
        for token in pairs(values) do
            local cell = result.cells[production.lhs][token]
            cell[#cell + 1] = production.number
        end
    end
    for _, lhs in ipairs(source.order) do
        for _, token in ipairs(terminals) do
            local cell = result.cells[lhs][token]
            if #cell > 0 then
                local chosen, first, follow = cell[1], false, false
                for _, number in ipairs(cell) do
                    if result.productions[number].reasons[token] == "FIRST" then
                        if not first then
                            chosen = number
                        end
                        first = true
                    else
                        follow = true
                    end
                end
                result.choices[lhs][token] = chosen
                if #cell > 1 then
                    local kind = first and (follow and "FIRST/FOLLOW" or "FIRST/FIRST") or "FOLLOW/FOLLOW"
                    result.conflicts[#result.conflicts + 1] = {lhs = lhs, token = token, numbers = cell, chosen = chosen, kind = kind}
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end
return M

local grammar = require("grammar_parser")
local transform = require("transform")
local first_follow = require("first_follow")
local ll_table = require("ll_table")
local driver = require("driver")
local function lines(path)
    local result = {}
    for line in io.lines(path) do
        result[#result + 1] = line
    end
    return result
end
local function append(target, values)
    for _, value in ipairs(values) do
        target[#target + 1] = value
    end
end
local function joined(heading, values)
    local fields = {}
    for _, value in ipairs(values) do
        fields[#fields + 1] = tostring(value)
    end
    return heading .. (#fields > 0 and " " .. table.concat(fields, " ") or "")
end
local function yes_no(value)
    return value and "yes" or "no"
end
local function less(first, second)
    for index, value in ipairs(first) do
        if value ~= second[index] then
            return value < second[index]
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function check_declarations(source)
    local result, names = {}, {}
    if source.has_declarations then
        for name in pairs(source.word_first) do
            if not source.declared[name] then
                names[#names + 1] = name
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(names)
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        result[#result + 1] = "undeclared terminal " .. name .. " at line " .. source.word_first[name]
    end
    return result
end
local function reachable(source)
    local found, queue, cursor = {[source.start] = true}, {source.start}, 1
    while cursor <= #queue do
        local lhs = queue[cursor]
        cursor = cursor + 1
        for _, rhs in ipairs(source.rules[lhs]) do
            for _, symbol in ipairs(rhs) do
                if grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) and not found[symbol] then
                    found[symbol], queue[#queue + 1] = true, symbol
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return found
end
local function clean(source)
    local result, diagnostics, undefined = grammar.copy(source), {}, {}
    for _, lhs in ipairs(result.order) do
        for _, rhs in ipairs(result.rules[lhs]) do
            for _, symbol in ipairs(rhs) do
                if grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) and not result.rules[symbol] then
                    undefined[symbol] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local names = {}
    for name in pairs(undefined) do
        names[#names + 1] = name
    end
    table.sort(names, function(a, b) return a:sub(2, -2) < b:sub(2, -2) end)
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        diagnostics[#diagnostics + 1] = "undefined nonterminal " .. name
    end
    local function remove_alternatives(removed, reason)
        for _, lhs in ipairs(result.order) do
            local retained = {}
            for _, rhs in ipairs(result.rules[lhs]) do
                local first = nil
                for _, symbol in ipairs(rhs) do
                    if removed[symbol] then
                        first = symbol
                        break
                    end
                end
                if first then
                    diagnostics[#diagnostics + 1] = "removed " .. grammar.production(lhs, rhs) .. " (" .. reason .. " " .. first .. ")"
                else
                    retained[#retained + 1] = rhs
                end
            end
            result.rules[lhs] = retained
        end
    end
    remove_alternatives(undefined, "undefined")
    local productive, changed = {}, true
    while changed do
        changed = false
        for _, lhs in ipairs(result.order) do
            if not productive[lhs] then
                for _, rhs in ipairs(result.rules[lhs]) do
                    local valid = true
                    for _, symbol in ipairs(rhs) do
                        if grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) and not productive[symbol] then
                            valid = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if valid then
                        productive[lhs], changed = true, true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local removed, order = {}, {}
    for _, lhs in ipairs(result.order) do
        if productive[lhs] then
            order[#order + 1] = lhs
        else
            removed[lhs], result.rules[lhs] = true, nil
            diagnostics[#diagnostics + 1] = "unproductive nonterminal " .. lhs
        end
    end
    result.order = order
    remove_alternatives(removed, "unproductive")
    local reached = reachable(result)
    order = {}
    for _, lhs in ipairs(result.order) do
        if reached[lhs] then
            order[#order + 1] = lhs
        else
            result.rules[lhs] = nil
            diagnostics[#diagnostics + 1] = "unreachable nonterminal " .. lhs
        end
    end
    result.order = order
    return result, diagnostics
end
local function left_recursion(source)
    local diagnostics = {}
    for _, start in ipairs(source.order) do
        local queue, visited, parent, cursor, found = {start}, {[start] = true}, {}, 1, nil
        while cursor <= #queue and not found do
            local lhs = queue[cursor]
            cursor = cursor + 1
            for _, rhs in ipairs(source.rules[lhs]) do
                local symbol = rhs[1]
                if symbol == start then
                    found = lhs
                    break
                elseif symbol and grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) and not visited[symbol] then
                    visited[symbol], parent[symbol], queue[#queue + 1] = true, lhs, symbol
                end
            end
        end
        if found then
            local path, current = {}, found
            while current ~= start do
                table.insert(path, 1, current)
                current = parent[current]
            end
            table.insert(path, 1, start)
            path[#path + 1] = start
            diagnostics[#diagnostics + 1] = "left recursion: " .. table.concat(path, " -> ")
        end
    end
    return diagnostics
end
local function prune(source)
    local result, log, diagnostics = grammar.copy(source), {}, {}
    local reached, order = reachable(result), {}
    for _, lhs in ipairs(result.order) do
        if reached[lhs] then
            order[#order + 1] = lhs
        else
            result.rules[lhs] = nil
            log[#log + 1] = "remove unreachable " .. lhs
            diagnostics[#diagnostics + 1] = "unreachable after transformation " .. lhs
        end
    end
    result.order = order
    return result, log, diagnostics
end
local function unused_declarations(source, final)
    local known, result = {}, {}
    for _, name in ipairs(first_follow.terminals(final)) do
        known[name] = true
    end
    if source.has_declarations then
        for _, name in ipairs(first_follow.terminal_order(source.declared)) do
            if not known[name] then
                result[#result + 1] = "unused token " .. name
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function summary(source)
    local productions, empty, unit = 0, 0, 0
    for _, lhs in ipairs(source.order) do
        for _, rhs in ipairs(source.rules[lhs]) do
            productions = productions + 1
            empty = empty + (#rhs == 0 and 1 or 0)
            unit = unit + (#rhs == 1 and grammar.is_nonterminal(rhs[1]) and 1 or 0)
        end
    end
    return "start=" .. source.start .. " nonterminals=" .. #source.order .. " terminals=" .. #first_follow.terminals(source) ..
        " productions=" .. productions .. " empty=" .. empty .. " unit=" .. unit
end
local function listing(source, numbered)
    local result, count = {}, 0
    local total = #ll_table.number(source)
    local width = #tostring(total)
    for _, lhs in ipairs(source.order) do
        for index, rhs in ipairs(source.rules[lhs]) do
            count = count + 1
            local prefix = index == 1 and lhs .. " -> " or string.rep(" ", #lhs) .. " | "
            if numbered then
                prefix = string.rep(" ", width - #tostring(count)) .. count .. "  " .. prefix
            end
            result[#result + 1] = prefix .. grammar.alternative(rhs)
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function grammar_report(cleaned, recursion, factored, final, recursion_log, factor_log, final_log)
    local result = {"== cleaned grammar ==", summary(cleaned)}
    append(result, listing(cleaned, false))
    for _, stage in ipairs({
        {"left recursion elimination", recursion, recursion_log, false},
        {"left factoring", factored, factor_log, false},
        {"final grammar", final, final_log, true}
    }) do
        append(result, {"", "== " .. stage[1] .. " =="})
        append(result, #stage[3] > 0 and stage[3] or {"none"})
        result[#result + 1] = summary(stage[2])
        append(result, listing(stage[2], stage[4]))
    end
    append(result, {"", "== cross reference =="})
    local symbols = {table.unpack(final.order)}
    append(symbols, first_follow.terminals(final))
    local productions = ll_table.number(final)
    for _, symbol in ipairs(symbols) do
        local numbers = {}
        for _, production in ipairs(productions) do
            for _, member in ipairs(production.rhs) do
                if member == symbol then
                    numbers[#numbers + 1] = production.number
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        local name = grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) and symbol or '"' .. symbol .. '"'
        result[#result + 1] = #numbers > 0 and joined(name .. " used in", numbers) or name .. " not used"
    end
    return result
end
local function sequence_score(symbols, scores)
    local length, height = 0, 0
    for _, symbol in ipairs(symbols) do
        if grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) then
            if not scores[symbol] then
                return nil
            end

            lhs,
            "  nullable: " .. yes_no(sets.nullable[lhs]),
            joined("  first:", first_follow.terminal_order(sets.first[lhs])),
            joined("  follow:", first_follow.terminal_order(sets.follow[lhs])),
            joined("  shortest:", sentences[lhs])

local function first_path(production, token, parse_table, sets)

        cursor = cursor + 1
        for _, symbol in ipairs(parse_table.productions[current].rhs) do
            if symbol == token then
                local path = {}
                while current ~= production.number do
                    table.insert(path, 1, current)
                    current = parent[current]
                end
                return path
            end
            if grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) then
                for _, candidate in ipairs(parse_table.productions) do
                    if candidate.lhs == symbol and not visited[candidate.number] then
                        visited[candidate.number], parent[candidate.number] = true, current
                        queue[#queue + 1] = candidate.number

        local path = paths[symbol]
        if symbol == source.start and token == "$" then
            return path
        end
        for _, production in ipairs(parse_table.productions) do
            for index, member in ipairs(production.rhs) do
                if member == symbol then
                    local suffix = {table.unpack(production.rhs, index + 1)}
                    local values, empty = first_follow.sequence(suffix, sets.nullable, sets.first)
                    local extended = {table.unpack(path)}
                    extended[#extended + 1] = production.number
                    if values[token] then
                        return extended
                    elseif empty and not paths[production.lhs] then
                        paths[production.lhs], queue[#queue + 1] = extended, production.lhs
                    end

local function table_report(source, sets, parse_table, conflicts_before)

        append(result, {production.number .. ": " .. production.notation, joined("  predict:", first_follow.terminal_order(production.predict))})
    end
    append(result, {"", "== parse table =="})
    local terminals = {table.unpack(sets.terminals)}
    terminals[#terminals + 1] = "$"
    local header = {""}
    append(header, terminals)
    local matrix, widths = {header}, {}

        local row = {lhs}
        for _, token in ipairs(terminals) do
            local cell, fields = parse_table.cells[lhs][token], {}
            for _, number in ipairs(cell) do
                fields[#fields + 1] = tostring(number)
            end
            row[#row + 1] = #fields > 0 and table.concat(fields, "/") or "."
        end
        matrix[#matrix + 1] = row
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(matrix) do
        for index, value in ipairs(row) do
            widths[index] = math.max(widths[index] or 0, #value)
        end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(matrix) do
        local line = row[1] .. string.rep(" ", widths[1] - #row[1])
        for index = 2, #row do
            line = line .. "  " .. string.rep(" ", widths[index] - #row[index]) .. row[index]
        end
        result[#result + 1] = line
    end
    append(result, {"", "== conflicts =="})
    if #parse_table.conflicts == 0 then
        result[#result + 1] = "none"
    end
    for _, conflict in ipairs(parse_table.conflicts) do
        result[#result + 1] = "conflict " .. conflict.lhs .. " on " .. conflict.token .. ": " .. conflict.kind .. ", chosen " .. conflict.chosen

                if grammar.is_nonterminal(child.symbol) and child.symbol:find("'", 1, true) and not child.mark then
                    append(children, child.children)
                else
                    children[#children + 1] = child
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #children == 1 and not node.mark then
        return children[1]
    end

            visit(child, next_prefix, index == #node.children)

    local widths, result = {0, 0, 0}, {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        for index = 1, 3 do
            widths[index] = math.max(widths[index], #row[index])
        end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        local line = ""
        for index = 1, 3 do
            line = line .. row[index] .. string.rep(" ", widths[index] - #row[index]) .. "  "
        end
        result[#result + 1] = line .. row[4]
    end
    return result
end

            if grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) then
                position = index
                break
            end
        end
        local value = {table.unpack(symbols, 1, position - 1)}
        append(value, productions[number].rhs)
        append(value, {table.unpack(symbols, position + 1)})

local function language(source, tokens)

    local by_lhs = {}
    for _, production in ipairs(productions) do
        by_lhs[production.lhs] = by_lhs[production.lhs] or {}
        by_lhs[production.lhs][#by_lhs[production.lhs] + 1] = production.number
    end

    for position = 0, #tokens do
        chart[position] = {items = {}, seen = {}}
    end

        local key = number .. ":" .. dot .. ":" .. origin
        local column = chart[position]
        if not column.seen[key] then
            column.seen[key] = true
            column.items[#column.items + 1] = {number = number, dot = dot, origin = origin}
        end
    end
    add(0, 0, 0, 0)
    for position = 0, #tokens do
        local cursor = 1

            local state = chart[position].items[cursor]
            cursor = cursor + 1
            local production = productions[state.number]
            if state.dot == #production.rhs then
                local prior = chart[state.origin].items
                local count = #prior
                for index = 1, count do
                    local waiting = prior[index]
                    local rhs = productions[waiting.number].rhs
                    if rhs[waiting.dot + 1] == production.lhs then
                        add(position, waiting.number, waiting.dot + 1, waiting.origin)
                    end
                end
            else
                local symbol = production.rhs[state.dot + 1]
                if grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) then
                    for _, number in ipairs(by_lhs[symbol]) do
                        add(position, number, 0, position)
                    end
                    local count = #chart[position].items
                    for index = 1, count do
                        local completed = chart[position].items[index]
                        local body = productions[completed.number]
                        if body.lhs == symbol and completed.dot == #body.rhs and completed.origin == position then

    if grammar.is_nonterminal(symbol) then
        local names = {}

        for name in pairs(parse_table.choices[symbol]) do
            present[name] = true
        end
        for _, name in ipairs(first_follow.terminal_order(present)) do
            names[#names + 1] = name == "$" and "$" or '"' .. name .. '"'
        end
        expected = table.concat(names, " ")

        expected = symbol == "$" and "$" or '"' .. symbol .. '"'
    end
    local recovery = event.kind == "skip" and 'skipped "' .. token .. '"' or

        if known[token] then

        else
            errors[#errors + 1] = 'unknown "' .. token .. '" at token ' .. position .. "; removed"
        end
    end

    result.original, result.unknown, result.errors = tokens, #errors, errors

local function one_parse(number, parsed, source, parse_table)

    result[#result + 1] = joined("left parse:", parsed.left_parse)
    result[#result + 1] = "stats: steps=" .. #parsed.trace .. " predicts=" .. parsed.counts.predict .. " matches=" .. parsed.counts.match .. " max_stack=" .. parsed.counts.max_stack
    if #parsed.errors > 0 then
        result[#result + 1] = "errors:"
        for _, message in ipairs(parsed.errors) do
            result[#result + 1] = "  " .. message
        end
    end
    result[#result + 1] = parsed.accepted and "result: accepted" or "result: rejected (errors: " .. #parsed.errors .. ")"
    result[#result + 1] = "language: " .. yes_no(parsed.language)
    if parsed.accepted then
        result[#result + 1] = "derivation:"
        append(result, derivation(source, parsed.left_parse, parse_table.productions))
    end
    result[#result + 1] = "tree:"
    append(result, tree_lines(parsed.root))
    result[#result + 1] = "compact tree:"

    return result

local function parses_report(inputs, source, sets, parse_table, sentences, context)
    local result, accepted, in_language, mismatches, used = {}, 0, 0, {}, {}
    local unknown, skip, pop, missing = 0, 0, 0, 0
    for number, parsed in ipairs(inputs) do
        append(result, one_parse(number, parsed, source, parse_table))
        result[#result + 1] = ""
        accepted = accepted + (parsed.accepted and 1 or 0)
        in_language = in_language + (parsed.language and 1 or 0)
        if parsed.accepted ~= parsed.language then
            mismatches[#mismatches + 1] = number
        end
        unknown, skip = unknown + parsed.unknown, skip + parsed.counts.skip
        pop, missing = pop + parsed.counts.pop, missing + parsed.counts.missing
        for _, number_used in ipairs(parsed.left_parse) do
            used[number_used] = true
        end
    end
    local unused = {}
    for _, production in ipairs(parse_table.productions) do
        if not used[production.number] then
            unused[#unused + 1] = production.number
        end
    end
    append(result, {
        "== summary ==",
        "inputs=" .. #inputs .. " accepted=" .. accepted .. " rejected=" .. #inputs - accepted .. " in_language=" .. in_language,
        joined("mismatches:", mismatches),
        "recovery: unknown=" .. unknown .. " skip=" .. skip .. " pop=" .. pop .. " missing=" .. missing,
        "coverage: " .. #parse_table.productions - #unused .. " of " .. #parse_table.productions .. " productions used",
        joined("unused:", unused)
    })
    for _, number in ipairs(unused) do
        local production = parse_table.productions[number]
        local outer = context[production.lhs]
        local example = {table.unpack(outer[1])}
        append(example, sentence(production.rhs, sentences))
        append(example, outer[2])
        local positions = {}
        for index = 1, #example do
            positions[index] = index
        end
        local parsed = driver.parse(example, positions, source, sets, parse_table)
        local present = false
        for _, number_used in ipairs(parsed.left_parse) do
            if number_used == number then
                present = true
            end
        end
        append(result, {
            "  " .. number .. ": " .. production.notation,
            joined("    example:", example),
            #parsed.events == 0 and "    result: accepted" or "    result: rejected (errors: " .. #parsed.events .. ")",
            "    used: " .. yes_no(present)
        })

    return result
end

                    created[#created + 1] = name
                    log[#log + 1] = "left factor " .. lhs .. " on " .. grammar.alternative(prefix) .. " with " .. name
                end
            end
        end
        result.rules[lhs] = alternatives
        for index, name in ipairs(created) do
            table.insert(result.order, cursor + index, name)
        end
        cursor = cursor + 1
    end
    return result, log
end
return M
